map.基于角膜内皮显微镜照片，计算内皮细胞密度(CD)、变异系数(CV)和六角形比例(: Based on endothelial microscope photos, compute endothelial cell density (CD), coefficient of variation (CV) and hexagon ratio (6A) to assess corneal endothelial function.

map.细胞密度 CD = 细胞数 / 框面积（cells/mm²）；变异系数 CV =: Cell density CD = cell count / frame area (cells/mm²); coefficient of variation CV = SD / mean cell area; hexagon ratio 6A = hexagon count / total cells × 100%
map.CD ≥ 2500 正常、1500–2500 临界、< 1500 低密度；CV: CD >= 2500 normal, 1500-2500 borderline, < 1500 low; CV < 0.30 normal, 0.30-0.40 borderline, > 0.40 abnormal; hexagon ratio >= 55% normal, 50%-55% borderline.
map.输入至少5个细胞的面积(μm²)，用于计算变异系数CV。: Enter areas of at least 5 cells (µm²) for CV.
map.统计各边数细胞数量，计算六边形(6边)细胞占比。: Count cells by edge number and compute the share of hexagonal (6-edge) cells.
map.正常成人CD约2500-3000 cells/mm²，随年龄递减。白内障术前CD: Normal adult CD is about 2500-3000 cells/mm², declining with age. Pre-cataract CD<1000 is high surgical risk.
map.⚠️ 角膜内皮计数需角膜内皮显微镜(如NIDEK CEM-530)拍摄，本工具仅: ⚠️ Corneal endothelial counting needs an endothelial microscope (e.g. NIDEK CEM-530); this tool only assists computation and cannot replace instrument auto-analysis.

map.镜面照相计数与面积求细胞密度 CD = 计数/面积（cells/mm²）。: Specular photo count and area give cell density CD = count/area (cells/mm²).
map.CD = 2500 / 1 = 2500 cells/mm²（正常成人约 200: CD = 2500 / 1 = 2500 cells/mm² (normal adult about 2000-3000); if CV is low and hexagons >60%, morphology is good.
map.若 CD<1000 提示内皮失代偿风险，白内障手术须谨慎评估。: If CD<1000 it signals endothelial decompensation risk; cataract surgery needs careful assessment.
map.新生儿约 3000–4000，成人约 2000–3000，随年龄与术后下降。: Newborn about 3000-4000, adult about 2000-3000, declining with age and after surgery.
map.CV 高表示细胞大小不均（多形性），是内皮功能受损的早期征象。: High CV means uneven cell sizes (polymegathism), an early sign of endothelial dysfunction.
